title: Cross-project peer route-claim and evidence-boundary audit
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and plan synthesis
scope: Refresh source-level scope and current project documentation for the main open-source DWG/DXF comparators
Separate DWG read, DXF read/write, callback projection, container parsing, and semantic/native claims
Reconcile related projects by implementation lineage so derivatives are not counted as independent parser votes
Translate route limits into a concise peer-admission and writer-acceptance gate without changing local queue order

sources.observation: The manual describes ongoing broad DWG reading but reports writer limits: R2007 is unsupported and R2010-R2018 output still has CRC/audit issues. The issue board shows residual reports in distinct read/write and DXF paths.
sources.limits: Manual and issue state do not prove a particular build's behavior or a libdxfrw defect. No peer source was built and no peer drawing was downloaded.

sources.observation: The project documents separate DWG/DXF reader routes and a typed document model; current issue reports are specific to writer or reader operations, versions, and record families.
sources.limits: Issue reports are not format authority or release-wide results. No package/source commit was executed in this pass.

sources.observation: The project documents ASCII/Binary DXF read/write, preservation of unfamiliar content except comments, and route-specific omissions in XREF import (including ACAD_TABLE and unknown entities); ACIS parsing is limited to a subset. The optional ODA converter is a separate external DWG route.
sources.limits: No DXF file was run through ezdxf. Base read/write, XREF import, ACIS parsing, and ODA conversion are not interchangeable evidence paths.

sources.observation: The public QCAD Community Edition is an open-source 2D DXF application, while the official license page says DWG and enhanced DXF support are supplied by proprietary Professional plugins. dxflib is described as a callback-oriented DXF library.
sources.limits: A QCAD CE/dxflib run cannot qualify DWG, proprietary QCAD Professional routes, full-model retention, or data not surfaced by callbacks.

sources.observation: The project describes a pre-alpha, spec-first DWG reader with container/object-stream work ahead of entity decoder coverage, no DXF parser, and a narrow permissive-license niche.
sources.limits: No build or run; self-reported corpus figures are not accepted as a comparable support denominator or semantic/native evidence.

sources.observation: These are useful downstream implementation/application routes but share ACadSharp/ACadRust ancestry and should not be counted as independent DWG decoder votes.
sources.limits: No source similarity audit or executable run was performed in this pass; the lineage note is limited to documented project dependencies already inventoried by the plan.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Consolidated peer-admission limits across DWG readers, DXF parsers/writers, callback libraries, application editions, and derived lineages. Made exact operation, version, family, identity/disposition accounting, and independent writer reopen explicit without adding a peer lane.
planImpact.nextImplementation: Continue the existing local fast implementation queue. Select no more than one peer for a specific unanswered question at its planned composed checkpoint; unavailable or out-of-profile routes are recorded and do not block local work.

method.limitations: Public documentation and issue indexes can change; mutable routes were not frozen to commit IDs in this research-only pass. The analysis is evidence classification, not an interoperability execution or compatibility result.

validation.scopedDiffCheck: PASS (git diff --check on plan and receipt paths)
